preguntas.pregunta: According to the unit, what main source of energy do plants use to live?
What does it mean that plants are autotrophs?
opciones: They produce organic compounds by photosynthesis
They feed by digesting other living organisms
They can only survive in water
They do not need carbon dioxide
preguntas.respuesta_correcta: They produce organic compounds by photosynthesis

preguntas.pregunta: Which combination is needed by plants to carry out photosynthesis?
opciones: Carbon dioxide, water, minerals and sunlight
Oxygen, glucose, soil heat and darkness
Water, oxygen, chlorophyll and no light
preguntas.respuesta_correcta: Carbon dioxide, water, minerals and sunlight

preguntas.pregunta: What is the function of vascular tissue in most plants?
opciones: Transporting water and minerals to different parts of the organism
Producing pollen grains inside the anther
Protecting the reproductive organs with petals
Making the plant completely unable to bend
preguntas.respuesta_correcta: Transporting water and minerals to different parts of the organism

preguntas.pregunta: Which statement best describes plant movement in the unit?
opciones: Most plants are fixed in the earth but can make some movements
All plants move from place to place like animals
Plants never show any kind of movement
Plants only move when they produce seeds
preguntas.respuesta_correcta: Most plants are fixed in the earth but can make some movements
